items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that adds the resulting value of the given AggregationExpression to the associated number.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 AggregationExpression，将给定 AggregationExpression 的计算结果累加到关联的数字上。

items.source: Add the evaluation result of the given AggregationExpression.
items.translation: 添加给定AggregationExpression的评估结果。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that adds the given value to the associated number.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，将给定值添加到关联的数字中。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that adds the value of fieldReference to the associated number.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，将 fieldReference 字段的值添加到关联的数字中。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。

items.source: Add the value stored at the given field.
items.translation: 添加给定字段中存储的值。

items.source: Uses of ArithmeticOperators.Add in org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation
items.translation: ArithmeticOperators.Add 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation 中的用途
